acc2: ACC-2: No test run on a single host, or on any deployment where DP1 or DP2 does not hold, establishes acceptance of the production contract. Every result of this suite is diagnostic evidence about the code's behaviour: separately authored verification (internal), not independent validation.

not_testable_before_an_implementation.ACC-1: an obligation on whoever claims a deployment complies (B-1, B-2 resolved): organisational, no behaviour of the code to test; the suite prints ACC-2 instead and makes no compliance claim
not_testable_before_an_implementation.E-Q-3a: an obligation on the operator's sizing of NOTICE_QUOTA and ALARM_RESERVE; the code is not required to refuse a smaller value, so there is nothing an implementation does or fails to do. Its consequences (E-X-4, N-6) are tested
not_testable_before_an_implementation.K-3/P-KEYS: that the engineer configures the witness's pinned gate keys: an operational precondition. K-CNT-4's detection of a difference is tested
not_testable_before_an_implementation.M-T-1 (real suspension): the behaviour of CLOCK_BOOTTIME across a REAL suspension (N-4) cannot be produced in a test; tested through the injected clock and a static source check only
not_testable_before_an_implementation.M-T-7/L-9: a pause from outside the machine is invisible by the text's own account
not_testable_before_an_implementation.E-X-2 (bound by provisioning): argued from the store's accounting, not testable at the mailbox interface
not_testable_before_an_implementation.I-E-9: by the text, the mailbox cannot check that a reading was from 0: there is nothing to test at the mailbox; the courier side (I-E-5) is tested
not_testable_before_an_implementation.ACC-2 (production): no test can establish the production contract (N-5); the runner enforces the statement
not_testable_before_an_implementation.O-3 (clearing an anchor): outside the specification by its own words
not_testable_before_an_implementation.E-R-1: a rule for "a reader" of GET /evidence; the specification names no reading component of the implementation (the courier stores evidence, it does not read it back), so the seam has nothing to bind. The suite's own reader applies it (S6-OBJ-01, S6-READ-01)
not_testable_before_an_implementation.C-2: a statement of what COVERED means, not a behaviour; each of its clauses is tested through C-1.1 to C-1.8, ST-1 to ST-9
not_testable_before_an_implementation.K-REC-4: a statement that records and notices are two channels; nothing to test beyond K-REC-1 (the record fails on its reports)
not_testable_before_an_implementation.I-O-3 (head that IS a position of the co: producing a genuine 409 CHAIN_POSITION whose head is behind the courier inside its own chain needs either the mailbox's key or a crash between store and answer; no seam for either was assumed. The other branch (not a position: state lost) is tested (C5-IE-02). Testable once a crash injection seam exists
